name: fmcsa_new_carrier_leads
title: FMCSA New Motor Carrier Leads: New Authority, Email & Phone
description: New motor carrier leads from the official FMCSA census: new USDOT/MC trucking companies with officer names, authority status, filed email and phone. Filter by state and fleet size; deduped, so daily runs only bill new carriers. 141 automated checks. (Apify actor transparent_meteorite/fmcsa-new-carrier-leads; pay-per-result.)

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: newCarriers (default) = the feed of carriers newly added to the FMCSA census in the last N days. lookup = look up specific carriers by USDOT number, MC/MX number or company name, any registration date; the date window, 'Only new since last run' and 'Only carriers with an email' are ignored.

states.title: States (2-letter)
states.description: Two-letter state codes to include, e.g. ["TX","FL","GA"]. Leave empty to get new carriers from every US state.

daysBack.title: New in the last N days
daysBack.description: Only carriers added to the FMCSA census in the last N days. 7 = this week's new authorities. Use 1-3 for a daily scheduled feed.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Hard cap on carriers returned, and charged, in this run. Each carrier is $0.0035 through October 21, 2026, then $0.008 (1,000 = $8).

requireEmail.title: Only carriers with an email
requireEmail.description: Return only carriers with an email address on their FMCSA filing. In our June 2026 sample of the 200 newest carriers, all 200 had one.

requirePhone.title: Only carriers with a phone
requirePhone.description: Return only carriers with a phone or cell number on file.

carrierOperation.title: Carrier operation type
carrierOperation.description: Interstate = hauls across state lines. Intrastate = operates inside one state only.

minPowerUnits.title: Minimum power units (fleet size)
minPowerUnits.description: Only carriers with at least this many trucks (power units). 0 = no minimum. Most new authorities run 1-5 trucks.

maxPowerUnits.title: Maximum power units (fleet size)
maxPowerUnits.description: Only carriers with at most this many trucks. 0 = no maximum.

minDrivers.title: Minimum drivers
minDrivers.description: Only carriers reporting at least this many drivers. 0 = no minimum.

maxDrivers.title: Maximum drivers
maxDrivers.description: Only carriers reporting at most this many drivers. 0 = no maximum.

hazmatOnly.title: Hazmat carriers only
hazmatOnly.description: Return only carriers flagged as hazardous-materials carriers in the FMCSA census.

forHireOnly.title: For-hire trucking companies only
forHireOnly.description: USDOT numbers are also issued to businesses that only move their own goods (contractors, landscapers, home improvement firms). Turn this on to keep only carriers registered as authorized or exempt for-hire, i.e. companies that haul freight for others. About 3 in 4 new registrations pass (Sept 2026 data).

authorityStatus.title: Operating authority status
authorityStatus.description: Keep only carriers whose operating authority (MC/MX docket) has this status in the FMCSA authority history. Brand-new carriers are usually Pending until their authority is granted. 'Any' (default) applies no filter.

includeAuthority.title: Include operating authority fields
includeAuthority.description: Adds authority_type, authority_status, authority_granted_date and per-docket history from the FMCSA authority dataset (one extra free public API call per 100 carriers). Turn off to skip it.

cargoTypes.title: Cargo types (any of)
cargoTypes.description: Only carriers that declare at least one of these cargo types on their filing. Keys: genfreight, household, metalsheet, motoveh, drivetow, logpole, bldgmat, mobilehome, machlrg, produce, liqgas, intermodal, passengers, oilfield, livestock, grainfeed, coalcoke, meat, garbage, usmail, chem, drybulk, coldfood, beverages, paperprod, utility, farmsupp, construct, waterwell, cargoothr.

nameContains.title: Company name contains
nameContains.description: Only carriers whose legal or DBA name contains this text (case-insensitive), e.g. LOGISTICS.

companyName.title: Company name (lookup mode)
companyName.description: Lookup mode: find carriers whose legal or DBA name contains this text (case-insensitive), e.g. WERNER. Same matching as 'Company name contains'; use either one.

dotNumbers.title: USDOT numbers (lookup mode)
dotNumbers.description: Look up these exact carriers by USDOT number, any registration date. When set, the 'new in the last N days' window is ignored. Turn off 'Only new since last run' and 'Only carriers with an email' to get every listed carrier.

mcNumbers.title: MC numbers (lookup mode)
mcNumbers.description: Look up carriers by MC (operating authority) number, digits only. Same behavior as USDOT lookup; can be combined with it.

webhookBatchSize.title: Webhook batch size
webhookBatchSize.description: How many records per webhook POST.

max_results.description: Max rows returned to the agent (default 25, hard cap 200). Billing is per result produced by the actor.

name: warn_layoff_alerts
title: WARN Layoff Notices API: 7 States (TX CA WA OR MD VA NC) $3/1k
description: WARN Act layoff notices from 7 official state sources (TX, CA, WA, OR, MD, VA, NC), verified by 89 passing tests. Clean rows: employer, workers affected, city, notice and layoff dates. Deduped across runs for scheduled alerts. CSV, JSON, API or webhook. $0.003 per notice. (Apify actor transparent_meteorite/warn-layoff-alerts; pay-per-result.)

states.title: States (2-letter)
states.description: States to pull (2-letter codes). Supported: TX (Texas open data), OR (Oregon HECC tracker), CA (California EDD current-quarter report), WA (Washington ESD database), MD (Maryland DLLR), VA (Virginia VEC/VirginiaWorks), NC (North Carolina Commerce). Any other code is skipped with a note in the log. Oregon rows include notices that Oregon filed for multi-state employers; the row's state field is the actual layoff location when the tracker gives one, and source_state is OR.

daysBack.title: Notices from the last N days
daysBack.description: Only notices with a notice date in the last N days (max 365). The Texas open-data feed is updated irregularly, so the default is a full year to make sure you always see the latest filings.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Hard cap on notices returned, and charged, in this run. Each notice is $0.003, so 50 notices = $0.15.

minLayoffCount.title: Minimum layoff count
minLayoffCount.description: Only notices that affect at least this many workers. 0 = no minimum. Try 100 for large layoffs only.

max_results.description: Max rows returned to the agent (default 25, hard cap 200). Billing is per result produced by the actor.

name: website_tech_stack_detector
title: Website Tech Stack Lookup: CMS, Frameworks, Hosting $0.002/site
description: 2,392 technology fingerprints with version and confidence, tested on 19,393 checks. Find the CMS, ecommerce platform, frameworks, analytics, CDN and hosting any website uses. Bulk domains in, one row per site with evidence. $0.002 per site, no subscription; failed sites are free. (Apify actor transparent_meteorite/website-tech-stack-detector; pay-per-result.)

urls.title: URLs or domains
urls.description: Websites to check, one per line. Bare domains (example.com) or full URLs both work; duplicates are removed. Only the homepage is fetched.

includeEvidence.title: Include evidence
includeEvidence.description: Add the header, script URL, cookie name or HTML snippet behind each detection, so you can check any result yourself.

maxSites.title: Max sites
maxSites.description: Upper bound on sites processed in this run. At $0.002 per analyzed site, 1,000 sites = $2. Failed and blocked sites are not charged.

respectRobots.title: Respect robots.txt
respectRobots.description: Skip sites whose robots.txt disallows the homepage for our user agent (WebsiteTechStackDetector). Skipped sites are not charged.

categoriesFilter.title: Only these categories
categoriesFilter.description: Return only technologies in these categories, for example CMS, Ecommerce, Analytics, CDN, Payment, Web servers. Case-insensitive. Leave empty to return every category (default). Sites are still charged per analyzed site, not per technology.

concurrency.title: Concurrency
concurrency.description: How many sites to fetch in parallel (each request goes to a different site). 5 is a good default; up to 20 for large lists.

max_results.description: Max rows returned to the agent (default 25, hard cap 200). Billing is per result produced by the actor.

name: ats_open_roles

description: Career-site jobs at $0.002 each, with seniority, department and ready-made company presets. (Apify actor transparent_meteorite/ats-open-roles; pay-per-result.)

companies.title: Companies (career-page URLs, names or slugs)
companies.description: One company per line. Paste a careers URL (boards.greenhouse.io/stripe, jobs.lever.co/spotify, jobs.ashbyhq.com/ramp, apply.workable.com/blueground, jobs.smartrecruiters.com/ServiceNow, bunq.recruitee.com, applied.bamboohr.com, acme.breezy.hr, shopify.pinpointhq.com, acme.jobs.personio.de, www.arbeitnow.com, remotive.com or remoteok.com for those remote-job feeds (attribution field included), or any career page with schema.org JobPosting markup) or just a company name or slug like "airbnb". A name is checked against all ten ATS APIs; a URL is more precise. Example: ["airbnb","https://jobs.lever.co/spotify","https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/ramp"].

companyPreset.title: Company preset
companyPreset.description: Add a ready-made list of verified public job boards: yc-top, ai-labs, fintech or devtools (several allowed, separated by commas). Each board returned live jobs when the list was last checked. If you leave Companies at its default, only the preset is fetched; anything else you type in Companies is added to the preset.

keywords.title: Keyword filter (any match)
keywords.description: Keep only jobs whose title, department or location contains at least one of these words (not case-sensitive), e.g. "engineer", "sales", "remote". Leave empty for every open job.

locations.title: Locations (any match)
locations.description: Keep only jobs whose location contains one of these strings (not case-sensitive), e.g. "Detroit", "Michigan", "United States".

remoteOnly.title: Remote jobs only
remoteOnly.description: Keep only jobs flagged remote by the employer or with "remote" in the location.

maxJobsPerCompany.title: Max jobs per company
maxJobsPerCompany.description: Newest matching jobs taken per company per run. 10 is enough for a quick look; raise it (up to 5,000) to get every open role.

excludeKeywords.title: Exclude keywords
excludeKeywords.description: Drop jobs whose title, department or location contains any of these words, e.g. "intern".

departments.title: Departments (substring, any match)
departments.description: Keep only jobs whose department contains one of these words (not case-sensitive), e.g. "engineering", "sales". Jobs with no department are dropped when this is set.

employmentTypes.title: Employment types
employmentTypes.description: Keep only jobs of these types: full-time, part-time, contract, intern, temporary. Only ATS vendors that publish an employment type can match (Lever, Ashby, BambooHR, Breezy, Personio, Recruitee, SmartRecruiters and schema.org pages do; Greenhouse usually does not). Jobs with no published type are dropped when this is set. Example: ["full-time","contract"].

postedWithinDays.title: Posted within last N days
postedWithinDays.description: Drop jobs posted longer ago than this. Jobs with no posted date are kept. 0 = no limit.

maxJobsTotal.title: Max jobs per run
maxJobsTotal.description: Hard cap on job rows, and charges, across all companies in this run. At $0.002 per job, 5,000 jobs = $10.

includeDescription.title: Include description text
includeDescription.description: Include the job description as plain text. Turn off for faster runs on SmartRecruiters and Workable (one less request per job). Same price either way.

monitorName.title: Monitor name
monitorName.description: Name of the saved baseline. Use a different name per watch list so schedules do not overwrite each other. Default is 'default'. Example: "eng-hiring".

max_results.description: Max rows returned to the agent (default 25, hard cap 200). Billing is per result produced by the actor.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Keep only items whose title or matter name contains ANY of these (not case-sensitive), e.g. zoning, rezone, liquor license, contract, bond. Leave empty for every item.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Hard cap on agenda items returned, and charged, in this run. At $0.001 per item, 1,000 items = $1.

bodyFilter.title: Body filter
bodyFilter.description: Part of the committee or body name, e.g. "planning", "city council", "budget". Not case-sensitive. Empty = all bodies.

dateFrom.title: Meetings from (YYYY-MM-DD)
dateFrom.description: Start of the meeting date range, YYYY-MM-DD. Leave empty to use "Days back".

dateTo.title: Meetings to (YYYY-MM-DD)
dateTo.description: End of the meeting date range, YYYY-MM-DD. Leave empty to use "Days ahead".

includeAttachments.title: Include attachment URLs
includeAttachments.description: Add attachment links (staff reports, ordinance text) per item.

includeMatterDetails.title: Include matter details (slower)
includeMatterDetails.description: One extra request per item with a matter, adds matterTitle, matterIntroDate, matterPassedDate, matterBodyName.

includeCancelled.title: Include cancelled meetings
includeCancelled.description: Include meetings whose agenda status is Cancelled.

maxEventsPerClient.title: Max meetings per city
maxEventsPerClient.description: Safety cap on meetings fetched per city per run.

max_results.description: Max rows returned to the agent (default 25, hard cap 200). Billing is per result produced by the actor.

domains.description: Company domains (example.com) or URLs. One output row per domain.

includeTechStack.description: Summarize CMS, analytics, CDN, ecommerce and framework detected on the homepage.

maxPagesPerDomain.description: Homepage plus up to N-1 of /contact, /about, /careers found in the homepage links.

timeoutSecs.title: Timeout per domain (seconds)

lookbackDays.title: Lookback (business days)
lookbackDays.description: How many business days of EDGAR filings to scan, counting only days that have a published EDGAR index. Today's index (not out until the evening) and holidays are skipped and do not use up the lookback.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Cap on filings delivered (and charged) this run. The default keeps a zero-config run under a minute.

industryGroups.title: Industry groups
industryGroups.description: Keep only these EDGAR industry groups. Empty = all.

states.title: Issuer states
states.description: Two-letter state or country codes of the issuer's business address (for example CA, NY, TX). Empty = all.

includeAmendments.title: Include amendments (Form D/A)
includeAmendments.description: Also return Form D/A amended filings. Off by default so you only see new raises.

excludePooledFunds.title: Exclude pooled investment funds
excludePooledFunds.description: Drop filings whose industry group is Pooled Investment Fund (VC, PE and hedge funds raising capital), leaving operating companies.

excludeLimitedPartnerships.title: Exclude limited partnerships and funds by name
excludeLimitedPartnerships.description: Also drop issuers whose name ends in LP, L.P., LLLP or Fund. Catches investment vehicles that file without marking themselves as a pooled fund. Off by default.

minAmountSold.title: Minimum amount sold (USD)

minOfferingAmount.title: Minimum offering amount (USD)
minOfferingAmount.description: Keep filings whose total offering amount is at least this. 0 = no minimum. Indefinite offerings are kept only when this is 0.

secUserAgent.title: SEC User-Agent
secUserAgent.description: Optional. Sent to sec.gov on every request. SEC requires a User-Agent with a contact email (for example "Acme Research you@acme.com"); without an email EDGAR answers HTTP 403. Leave empty to use the actor's own compliant User-Agent.

max_results.description: Max rows returned to the agent (default 25, hard cap 200). Billing is per result produced by the actor.

maxLinksToCheck.title: Max links checked per page

requestDelayMs.title: Delay between requests to one host (ms)

userAgent.title: User-Agent
userAgent.description: Sent on every request and matched against robots.txt (the default token is TechnicalSeoAuditBot). Leave the default unless a site needs you to identify yourself differently.

maxDomains.description: Cap on domains looked up (and charged) this run.

maxItems.description: Stop after this many jobs (1 to 1000). You are charged per job delivered.

includeDescription.title: Include description
includeDescription.description: Plain-text job description. Same cost either way; turn off for a lighter dataset.

includeDescriptionHtml.title: Also include description HTML
includeDescriptionHtml.description: Adds descriptionHtml with the original formatting.

includeCompanyDetails.title: Include company details
includeCompanyDetails.description: Adds website, industry, size and headquarters from the public LinkedIn company page (one extra request per unique company, cached). Skipped automatically if LinkedIn walls it.

max_results.description: Max rows returned to the agent (default 25, hard cap 200). Billing is per result produced by the actor.

name: meta_ad_library
title: Meta Ad Library Scraper: Facebook & Instagram Ads
description: Image or video URL on 100% of ads vs 70% in our side-by-side test, at $0.00065 per ad. Search the public Meta Ad Library by keyword, advertiser Page id or library URL. No login. Flat rows: ad text, headline, link, CTA, media URLs, ISO dates, platforms, variations. (Apify actor transparent_meteorite/meta-ad-library; pay-per-result.)

searchTerms.title: Search terms
searchTerms.description: Keywords or advertiser names, one per line (for example "running shoes"). Each term is searched in the public Ad Library.

pageIds.title: Advertiser Page ids
pageIds.description: Numeric Facebook Page ids (the view_all_page_id in an Ad Library URL). Returns every ad that Page runs. Example: ["866655706540346"].

libraryUrls.title: Ad Library URLs
libraryUrls.description: Paste search URLs copied from facebook.com/ads/library. Their filters are used as they are. Example: ["https://www.facebook.com/ads/library/?active_status=active&ad_type=all&country=US&q=running%20shoes"].

country.title: Country
country.description: Two-letter country code, or ALL. Ads shown in this country. Example: "US", "GB", "ALL".

activeStatus.title: Active status
activeStatus.description: Which ads to include. Choose active for ads running now, inactive for ended ads, all for both.

adType.title: Ad type
adType.description: All ads is the commercial default. Political and issue ads add Meta's published spend and impression ranges.

mediaType.title: Media type
mediaType.description: Filter by creative type. Choose all unless you need only one creative type.

dateFrom.title: Started on or after
dateFrom.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Only ads that started running on or after this date. Example: "2026-01-01".

dateTo.title: Started on or before
dateTo.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Only ads that started running on or before this date. Example: "2026-10-01".

platforms.title: Platforms
platforms.description: Optional. Any of: facebook, instagram, audience_network, messenger, threads. Example: ["facebook","instagram"].

languages.title: Ad languages
languages.description: Optional language codes such as en, es. The library filters by these; they are echoed in the languages field. Example: ["en","es"].

maxItems.title: Max ads
maxItems.description: Total ads to deliver across all targets. You are charged per ad.

max_results.description: Max rows returned to the agent (default 25, hard cap 200). Billing is per result produced by the actor.
